name: solution-architecture
prompt: We're doing order management for a retailer. Can you draw the solution architecture: Commerce Cloud takes the orders, Sales Cloud holds accounts and opportunities, MuleSoft pushes the orders to SAP, Data Cloud unifies the customer profile, and there's an Agentforce service agent on top that answers order-status questions.

name: data-model
prompt: need the data model for our promotions feature. Account has many Promotion__c (lookup, optional), and each Promotion__c has Promotion_Line__c children that die with it. Lines also point to a Product2. Show the main fields, put it in a doc for the BA team.
expect: an image or doc for the BA team

name: oauth-png
prompt: can you do the oauth web server flow w/ PKCE for our external client app, need a png for the confluence page (white bg is fine, make it big enough to read)
expect: a PNG, or an honest note that it could not be made plus an SVG

name: erd-from-sfdx
prompt: Make an ERD of the custom objects in this repo and retitle it 'Promotions data model'. Keep it to the objects we actually built, plus Account since they point at it.
fixture: an SFDX project with Promotion__c (lookup to Account), Promotion_Line__c (master-detail to Promotion__c) and one Account field
expect: only the built objects plus Account

name: lead-process
prompt: Document how a Lead gets handled in our org for the workshop tomorrow: marketing hands over MQLs, SDRs qualify them, AEs take the qualified ones and convert them, and leads can be recycled or disqualified along the way. I want people to see both who does what and what statuses a lead can be in.

name: agentforce
prompt: We're building an Agentforce returns agent for the web chat and WhatsApp. Topics: Order Status and Returns. It looks up orders and creates return cases, grounded on our returns policy knowledge article. Give me the interaction map, and for the Returns topic show the step-by-step instruction diagram with the guardrail that it never promises a refund amount.

name: discovery-personas-hierarchy
prompt: We run discovery for a utilities company next week: give me the personas and an L0/L1 process hierarchy for customer service

name: discovery-current-future
prompt: for the discovery readout I need a current vs future state slide: legacy CRM, a shared mailbox and an excel dispatch sheet today, going to Service Cloud, Email-to-Case and Field Service. show what replaces what

name: territory-model
prompt: We're implementing Enterprise Territory Management for a software company. Draw the territory model: Global Sales splits into EMEA, Americas and APAC, each with countries and an enterprise vs mid-market segment. Show owner, the assignment rule and the account count, and mark APAC as phase 2.
expect: rule and account count in the cards

name: omni-channel-routing
prompt: Service Cloud project: web chat, WhatsApp, email-to-case and phone need to be routed through Omni-Channel. Chat and WhatsApp share a messaging queue, email goes to a case queue for billing specialists, phone goes to a voice queue for the VIP desk. If nobody picks up after 5 minutes it goes to an overflow queue. Draw it.
expect: skills on the edges or cards
overflow path drawn as an exception

name: experience-site-map
prompt: For the customer and partner portal on Experience Cloud, give me a site map: public pages (home, help centre, contact us, login), a customer area (cases, account, orders) and a partner area (deal registration, resources, dashboard). Show the audience and key components for each page.
